Segment→HubSpot diagnosed: mapping demands email, apps send anonymous events. Changed nothing.
events.detail: Root cause, verified live: the HubSpot Cloud Mode (Actions) destination is enabled and authenticated fine — the breakage is a data/mapping mismatch. The only mapping, 'Lead Events Upsert Contact', fires on Track (All) and maps HubSpot's required Email field from properties.email. SPIIX source events carry NO email anywhere — the sample failed event ('Note Cracked' from piggybank) has empty properties, no traits, null userId. Segment rejects every such event with 'Payload Validation Failed — The root value is missing the required field email', never calls HubSpot, and does not retry. 7-day: 2,230 received / 823 failed / 4 delivered (0.2%).
options: Fix the SPIIX source: include properties.email on track events, or send identify calls with email
Narrow the mapping: change the Email field source, or trigger only on events that carry an email
Disable the mapping for anonymous events
events.decision: Diagnose only — zero dashboard changes. Mapping editor opened for inspection and exited without saving. Options brought back to Steve.
events.outcome: Awaiting Steve's tap. Still failing: 0.2% delivered.

events.text: Livelog v1 architecture call: static JSON feed + poll, no realtime infra.
events.detail: Steve ordered an unlisted real-time ops log under /scaffolding — queries, dialogues, AI conversations, processing, as a running log. The question was how to make it 'real-time' on a static site.
options: Static JSON feed (public/ai-ops-log.json) + client polling — simple, static-hosting safe
WebSocket/SSE realtime infra — true realtime, needs a server, persistence, and ops overhead
events.decision: JSON feed with a python writer, 10s client poll, entries go live on push. Unlisted, noindex, terminal-style UI.
events.outcome: Live at /scaffolding/livelog. Deploy READY on commit c0127d9. PLX-607 Done.

events.text: Livelog v2: news-first stream with expandable logs and AI decision trees.
events.detail: Steve's follow-up: 'STREAM WITH MORE DETAILS. EFFECTIVELY VIEW LOGS AND AI DECISION TREES. STARTS WITH NEWS AND DESCENDS.' The page becomes a news feed — newest headline at top, expanding into full log detail, with decision-kind entries rendering the AI's reasoning chain (trigger → options weighed → decision → outcome) as an actual tree.
options: True streaming via SSE/long-poll endpoint — needs a serverless function, cache-busting, more moving parts
Tighter polling (3s) + push convention + animated stream feel — near-realtime, static-safe
events.decision: 3s poll with cache-bust, newest-first stream, expandable headlines, CSS decision trees, flash-in animation on new entries, LIVE indicator. Decision-tree fields added to log-event.py first-class.
